However, constancy only through n=10 is not itself a proof of the true stabilization threshold unless supported by a general bound; the record properly marks 59 trajectories still increasing at 10 but its 'stabilized-in-window' labels remain finite-window observations.

A small core-weight ≤4 census over n≤10 is therefore at most a finite illustration unless it improves a known bound or exposes a structural phenomenon not implied by existing stability theory.

No new general bound, proof mechanism, or representation-theoretic consequence is supplied.
